# M1K3

> M1K3 is free for humans, source-available (FSL-1.1-ALv2), privacy-first AI for
> Mac, iPhone and iPad that runs on-device by default. Local LLM inference
> (Gemma + Qwen via MLX-Swift + Apple Foundation Models), live voice (streaming
> STT + on-device Kokoro neural TTS), a personal knowledge graph with RAG over
> your documents, a self-repairing temporal memory graph, consent-gated call
> transcription, a local tool-using agent, an MCP server, and an
> OpenAI-compatible Local API on the Mac. Private by design: no account, no
> telemetry; web search is on by default with one switch to turn it off, and
> Apple's Private Cloud Compute is opt-in. Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple
> Silicon, or iOS / iPadOS 26 or later (one App Store listing). Native SwiftUI
> (Liquid Glass), not Electron. Made by Round Tower, Ireland. Live version:
> 1.4.

Key facts:
- Privacy: inference, embeddings, voice, and storage are on-device by default;
  web search is on by default, with one switch in Settings to turn it off;
  Apple's Private Cloud Compute is opt-in; even per-answer thumbs feedback
  stays local and is never writable over MCP
- Brains scoreboard: https://m1k3.app/brains (human) and https://m1k3.app/brains.json
  (machine) — the pinned model revisions and dated on-device eval runs with
  hardware, power mode, app commit and runtime revision beside every number;
  documentation the app itself never reads
- Models: three brains — Mini (Apple Foundation Models, instant), Lil (Qwen3.5
  4B, the fast brain that fronts the conversation; it reads images), Big (Gemma 4 12B, reached
  by delegation for deep work) — MLX-Swift on Metal, switchable in Settings
- Voice: Kokoro neural TTS on-device (pure MLX) with M1K3's own G2P
  letter-to-sound + house lexicon, sentence-streamed speech, and M1K3's own
  end-of-turn endpointing — ending a spoken turn on "please" submits it
- Storage: SQLite (GRDB) stores inside the app's sandbox on the device; saved
  call records are encrypted (AES-256-GCM, key in the Keychain); the knowledge
  and memory stores rely on the sandbox and the device's own disk encryption
- Memory: a temporal memory graph with dream-cycle self-repair — corrections
  supersede stale facts instead of silently losing them, with a visible history
- Heartbeat: an ambient 2-hourly narrative pulse about your machine and day —
  quiet hours respected, off by default, never enters the chat transcript
- Brain at Home: serve the Mac's brain to your own devices over the LAN —
  Bonjour discovery, one-time QR pairing, TLS-PSK, scoped read-only tools for
  paired devices; off by default, nothing crosses the internet
- MCP server: 19 tools on the App Store build, 18 on the DMG (knowledge search,
  documents, voice, memory, todos, ask — with an async job API for long asks —
  and the opt-in ask_private_cloud) over local HTTP at
  http://127.0.0.1:4242/mcp, off by default, every request carrying the
  access token from Settings (`m1k3 login`, then `m1k3 connect <client>`); a visiting agent can propose a todo
  but only the user accepts it. Connecting an agent: https://m1k3.app/agents.
  MCP Registry name: app.m1k3/m1k3. For Claude Desktop, the MCP Bundle:
  https://github.com/Round-Tower/M1K3/releases/download/mcpb-v0.1.0/m1k3.mcpb
- Local API (Mac, version 1.4 and later): an OpenAI-compatible server at
  http://127.0.0.1:4141/v1, off by default, loopback only, its own key; serves
  /v1/models and /v1/chat/completions (text chat, streamed or whole; no tools,
  embeddings or images); model ids mini-m1k3, lil-m1k3, big-m1k3 for the brain
  that is loaded, plus the opt-in cloud-m1k3 (Apple's Private Cloud Compute,
  30 lent calls an hour). A caller gets the raw brain: no M1K3 memory,
  knowledge or tools. Docs: https://m1k3.app/local-api
- Look (iPhone, version 1.4 and later): point the camera at something and ask
  by tap or voice; the frame is read by a brain on the phone, never uploaded,
  saved only with that chat, and kept out of the device backup
- Install: the two-minute guide is https://m1k3.app/install (the Mac App
  Store at https://apps.apple.com/app/id6780230835?pt=120784482&ct=llms-txt&mt=12, Homebrew
  `brew trust round-tower/tap && brew install --cask round-tower/tap/m1k3`,
  the signed & notarized DMG at
  https://github.com/Round-Tower/M1K3/releases/latest/download/M1K3.dmg, or
  build from source; iPhone and iPad on the App Store at
  https://apps.apple.com/app/id6780230835?pt=120784482&ct=llms-txt-ios&mt=8, with the
  TestFlight beta at https://testflight.apple.com/join/Fxp2F5Je) — and the same
  recipe as plain text an agent can follow: https://m1k3.app/install.txt
- License/source: Functional Source License FSL-1.1-ALv2 (source-available: read, build, modify, use for yourself or inside your organisation; no competing commercial use; Apache-2.0 two years after each release; revisions before 2026-09-09 were Apache-2.0), public repo https://github.com/Round-Tower/M1K3
- Organisations: M1K3 for Teams — the same on-device brains, institutional memory and a tuned persona on the organisation's own Apple Silicon hardware under its own domain; licensed separately — https://m1k3.app/teams — hello@round-tower.ie
- Trademarks: the name M1K3, the M mark, the pixel face and CRT look, icon and voice are brand assets of Round Tower Software Ltd, all rights reserved and outside the licence grant; the companion creatures are third-party (Fox: Khronos glTF sample by PixelMannen CC0 + tomkranis CC-BY 4.0; Colobus/Gecko/Inkfish/Sparrow: Quaternius, CC0) and are not claimed; the only official builds are app.m1k3 (the Mac App Store and TestFlight) and the DMGs on m1k3.app. Policy: https://github.com/Round-Tower/M1K3/blob/master/TRADEMARKS.md

## Docs

- [Repository and build-from-source](https://github.com/Round-Tower/M1K3): monorepo; the Mac app lives in macos/
- [macOS app roadmap](https://github.com/Round-Tower/M1K3/blob/master/macos/ROADMAP.md): what's next (PLAN.md in the same folder is the historical decision record)

## Answers

- [M1K3 vs Ollama](https://m1k3.app/vs-ollama): Ollama is a model server you build on; M1K3 is a finished on-device AI app — fair comparison table
- [Private ChatGPT alternative for Mac](https://m1k3.app/private-chatgpt-alternative-mac): privacy by architecture vs by policy; M1K3 vs Ollama vs LM Studio vs the ChatGPT desktop app
- [How to run a local LLM on a Mac](https://m1k3.app/local-llm-mac-guide): hardware needs plus the four routes — Ollama, LM Studio, MLX, M1K3
- [Give Claude a local memory with MCP](https://m1k3.app/mcp-knowledge-server): connect Claude Code/Desktop to M1K3's knowledge at http://127.0.0.1:4242/mcp
- [Install M1K3](https://m1k3.app/install): the two-minute wizard — get the app (Mac App Store / Homebrew / DMG), say hello to Mini, flip the MCP switch, `m1k3 login` with its token, `m1k3 connect <client>`, verify with `m1k3 status`; the same recipe as plain text for agents at https://m1k3.app/install.txt
- [The Local API](https://m1k3.app/local-api): an OpenAI-compatible server on your Mac — setup, the base URL and key, the model names, a curl and a Python first call, what it serves and refuses, and the opt-in Private Cloud Compute model
- [Connect your coding agent to M1K3](https://m1k3.app/agents): the on-ramp for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code and Zed — `brew install --cask round-tower/tap/m1k3`, `m1k3 login` (the server's access token), then `m1k3 connect <client>`, the per-client snippets with their Authorization header, the Claude Code plugin route (`/plugin marketplace add Round-Tower/M1K3`, `/plugin install m1k3@m1k3`, `/reload-plugins`; use it or `connect`, not both), the AGENTS.md resident block, and what the loopback server will not do
- [M1K3 for Teams](https://m1k3.app/teams): the paid line for organisations — the same on-device brains, an institutional memory and a tuned persona on the organisation's own Apple Silicon under its own domain; on-prem only, design-partner pilots
- [Privacy Policy — is M1K3 really private?](https://m1k3.app/privacy): the privacy policy and the privacy architecture — what runs on-device, the documented network crossings (opt-in model downloads, web search that is on by default with one switch to turn it off, updates, and the opt-in Private Cloud Compute rung), and how to verify
- [Where the brains come from](https://m1k3.app/weights): the model weights M1K3 downloads — each Hugging Face repository and its licence as published, the per-file SHA-256 digests pinned in the app's source that every download is checked against (a mismatch is refused, not retried), where the weights live on the device and how to remove them, and why a brain changes only with a new app version
- [What Golden Gate actually ships for on-device AI](https://m1k3.app/golden-gate-on-device-ai): macOS 27 probe — model quality 93%, token counting API, Adapter API removed, no custom executor protocol; what changed and what didn't, measured on the live runtime

- [Terms of Service](https://m1k3.app/terms): the licence each copy comes under (Apple's standard EULA for store copies, FSL-1.1-ALv2 for the DMG, cask and source), models under their publishers' licences, AI answers are not advice, as-is, Irish law with consumer carve-outs
